system.description: The Baali voices a curse against a target and engages in a Static Willpower Challenge against a difficulty equal to the target's Willpower Traits. On success, the Baali permanently sacrifices a number of Mental Traits, and for each Trait sacrificed may reduce one of the target's Attributes, Virtues, or Willpower by one Trait (minimum one). The Baali may end the curse at will, though abuse risks the infernal patrons turning the curse back on the Baali.
